synth.notes: Two mirrored cyan blocks slide on a 4x4-cell grid: A1/A2 move both up/down, A3 apart, A4 together; per-block blocked by maze cells {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14)}, marker cells and half bounds. Clicking a marker arms: blocks become colour-1 players, that marker turns active and A1-4 steer it by one cell with the same blockers; click inactive marker = switch, click player = disarm, click block/active marker/empty = no-op; A5/A7 no-ops. Two wall_0 bars grow to w=floor(3(n+1)/7), n=actions since level start (continuity-gated counter, fallback n=(7w-1)//3). Names type_color_rank sorted by (y,x); blocks hold ranks 0,1 in block mode. Unconfirmed: click hit-test outside object origins.
